Health.headline: West Nile Virus Outbreak: 290 Cases, 24 Deaths in Greece; Cyprus Calls for Calm
Health.summary: Greece is experiencing a significant West Nile virus outbreak, with 290 reported cases and 24 deaths, prompting a call for calm from neighboring Cyprus. Health authorities are urging precautions, particularly among vulnerable populations. The spread highlights the ongoing public health challenge posed by mosquito-borne diseases in the region.
key_points: Greece faces a West Nile virus outbreak with 290 cases and 24 deaths.
Cyprus has called for calm amid the regional health concern.
Public health measures are urged to protect vulnerable populations from the mosquito-borne disease.
